verdict.rationale: replica-skill is a Claude Code skill pack, so shipping a skill-authoring spec, template, or meta-skill is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only covers installing and running its existing app-cloning skills (marketplace install, pasting a SKILL.md, copying folders into .claude/skills/). Nothing shows a spec, template, or meta-skill an agent could follow to author and package a new skill end to end.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can author and package a new skill end to end by following the project's own spec, template, or meta-skill
